events.description: Plotting the main coordinate axes and the cubic curve with its label.
events.clip_query: A blue cubic curve is plotted on a set of grey coordinate axes with a label in the upper right corner.

events.description: Adding a tiny set of local axes at a specific point on the curve.
events.clip_query: A tiny, barely visible set of local axes appears on the blue curve.

events.description: The camera zooms in dramatically on the local axes, making the curve look like a straight line.
events.clip_query: The camera zooms in extremely close to a point on the curve until the curve appears linear and the local axes fill the screen.
